title: Pan-Seared Irish Lamb Chops
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for Irish lamb chops, seared to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: 1. Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Season the lamb chops with salt and black pepper.
3. Add the olive oil to the preheated skillet.
4. Sear the lamb chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
5. Remove the lamb chops from the skillet and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
6. Serve the lamb chops hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
